description_en: Modifies the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID
description_zh: 根据计算资源ID，修改指定的计算资源
name: UpdateComputeResource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the computing resource
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The category of the computing resource to be added. Different types have different subtypes and corresponding parameter schema constraints. Examples: InstanceMode and UrlMode
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源添加的类别，不同type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数schema约束，场景举例：InstanceMode 实例模式；UrlMode 连接串模式
parameters.name: connection_properties_mode

parameters.help_en: The description of the computing resource. The maximum length is 3000 characters
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源描述信息，长度不超过 3000 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The specific connection configuration of the computing resource, including the connection address, access identity, and environment information. The environment type (EnvType) of the computing resource is a member attribute of this object, including DEV (development environment) and PROD (production environment). The value is not case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。计算资源环境EnvType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括DEV（开发环境）和PROD（生产环境），不区分大小写
parameters.name: connection_properties

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the computing resource was modified successfully:

true: Yes

false: No
Success.description_zh:
计算资源是否修改成功：
true：是
false：否
